assets.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: original transparent runtime planet terrain for a premium pixel-art H5 game, Loststar. Create ONE fully closed spherical miniature orange cardboard desert planet, 3/4 overhead orthographic camera, perfectly circular full globe silhouette including strongly rounded underside, not a floating island, no cutaway, diameter fills 85% of square canvas. Crisp high-density pixel art with 1–3px deliberate pixel clusters, intricate hand-crafted look, restrained dithering, warm golden-orange light upper left, rust-orange land, deep burgundy and violet shaded lower hemisphere with cyan rim. Tiny folded corrugated cardboard cliffs, parcel strata, small postage-label scraps, violet metal pipes embedded into underside, tiny green succulent clumps. Upper surface is gently convex with a broad EMPTY winding sandy path from lower-left of upper hemisphere toward center-right, keep central walkable area clear. A few small stacked parcel formations and one abandoned sorting antenna at far rear rim only, NO large front buildings. Strong spherical shading. Pure actual transparent background, no stars, no orbit, no ground shadow outside globe. NO robots, no creatures, no spacecraft, no characters, no text, no UI, no panel, no watermark. This is a clean independent game layer, not a screenshot or concept collage.

Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: original pixel-art game background layer for Loststar, a cozy strange space lost-property station. Portrait composition 3:4. High-density deliberate crisp pixel clusters, 16-bit artisanal detailed pixel art with violet navy shadows, amber practical lights, pale cyan screens, weathered lilac stone and metal. Interior of an abandoned postal observatory, enormous arched window on left opens into a very deep purple star field, NO planets visible outside. Lower left a small parked cream and rust orange retro spacecraft with blue windshield. Right half built-in TWO rows of EMPTY glass display cabinets on dark brass shelves, warm small lamps above each empty display dome. Bottom third clear tiled station floor and a few tangled cables and succulent plants at corners. Open central floor area for a separately animated robot sprite. Beautiful atmospheric composition, detailed yet readable at phone size. No UI, no writing, no text, no labels, no humans, no robots, no creatures, no items inside cabinets, no watermarks. Full-bleed background, not a poster or collage.

Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: production transparent pixel-art sprite atlas for an original H5 miniature orange parcel-desert planet game. ONE square sheet exactly divided into 2 by 2 equal cells with wide TRANSPARENT gutters. Exactly FOUR separate isolated sprites, one centered within each quadrant, ALL fully visible and no overlaps, each occupies 65% of its cell leaving transparent margin. Crisp hand-crafted high-density pixel art, deliberate small pixel clusters, dark purple 1–2px outlines, top-left warm light, violet shadows and cyan accents, three-quarter isometric view facing lower left. TOP LEFT: cute small cream box-headed exploration robot, black rectangular face with TWO cyan eyes, cream chassis, orange headphone-like side panels, jointed arms, small dark purple feet, yellow antenna light. TOP RIGHT: small cream and orange retro postal spaceship, dark blue glass windshield, orange rounded nose pointing right, small swept fins, rear nozzle left, NO flame. Transparent background is essential. No ground, no extra decorations, no text, no labels, no dividing lines, no UI, no shadows outside sprite footprint. Exact same art style across all four sprites.
